text: GLOBAL MARKETS BRACE FOR INTEREST RATES TO STAY ELEVATED THROUGH 2031 Traders increasingly expect the Federal Reserve, ECB and Bank of England to keep interest rates elevated for years after completing further hikes in 2027, according to Bloomberg.
